svg.title: Flow matching: training and sampling
svg.desc: Training draws noise x0, data x1 and time t, forms x_t on the straight line between them and regresses the network v_theta(x_t, t) onto the constant velocity x1 - x0. Sampling starts from noise and integrates dx/dt = v_theta(x, t) with Euler steps from t = 0 to t = 1. The same network weights are used in both.
svg.text: Flow matching: what the network learns, and what gets integrated
One network predicts a velocity. Training regresses it on straight-line velocities. Sampling follows it as an ODE from noise to data.
regress the network on random (noise, data, time) draws
same network, same weights θ (frozen after training)
integrate the network's velocity field from t = 0 to t = 1
each arrow is one Euler step;
the path bends; its end is the sample
vector in data space (same shape as a data sample)
